# UCSD Cinematic Arts Program

> > UC San Diego's interdisciplinary undergraduate program combining film studies, film production, and cinematic theory across Visual Arts, Communication, Literature, and Theater & Dance departments.

The Cinematic Arts Program at UCSD offers students a comprehensive film education that integrates theoretical analysis with hands-on production experience. Administered through the Visual Arts Department with support from Communication, Literature, and Theater & Dance, the program emphasizes critical thinking about cinema as both an art form and cultural practice.

## Key Topics

- Cinematic Arts Major
- Film Studies
